overview.description: The Amplify Fairlead Tactical Bitcoin ETF (BNAV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long btc, short usd currency. The fund is an actively managed ETF that provides exposure to Bitcoin (BTC) through ETPs, options, and futures contracts. The fund employs a proprietary model to determine its BTC exposure between 70% and 150% based on evolving market trends. BNAV was launched on Jul 29, 2026 and is issued by Amplify Investments.
